sentences.text:
It is frankly submitted by the learned advocate for the opposite party no.2 that the petitioner cannot claim more than Rs.5000/- towards maintenance and the amount of Rs.2000/- which was granted as a pre-condition for bail shall be adjusted with the maintenance allowance which was granted on 25.07.2019.
5.

In view of the such circumstances, it is clarified that the petitioner shall go on paying Rs.5000/-
per month only to the opposite party no.2 from the date of the order passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Siwan.

6. This order will not debar or preclude the opposite party no.2 from claiming enhancement or alteration of maintenance allowance under Section 127 of the Cr.P.C.
7.
Accordingly, the present criminal revision application stands disposed of.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J) mdrashid/-
